# StatusClear

> StatusClear is a free Android app, with no ads, that stops WhatsApp from blurring your Status. It re-encodes videos and photos on your phone to full HD 1080×1920 under WhatsApp Status's ~1.4 Mbps re-compression limit, so WhatsApp posts them untouched. It is a free, open-source alternative to PureStatus. Made by Victor Conqueror (Conqueror102 on GitHub).

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no account, no watermark.
- Platform: Android 8.0 or newer. No iPhone version yet. Works with WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business.
- Privacy: requests no Android permissions, not even internet access. Everything happens offline on the phone.
- License: open source, GPL-3.0. Source code: https://github.com/Conqueror102/StatusClear
- Download (APK): https://github.com/Conqueror102/StatusClear/releases/latest/download/StatusClear-arm64-v8a.apk
- Not on the Google Play Store yet, so Android shows its standard "install unknown apps" warning, as it does for any app installed from a website.
- Creator: Victor Conqueror, independent full-stack developer. https://github.com/Conqueror102 · https://victor-onyemaechi.vercel.app
- Not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta or PureStatus.

## Why WhatsApp Status gets blurry

Measured on a real phone with labelled test clips (November 2026): WhatsApp Status left clips at 1.12–1.39 Mbps untouched and re-encoded clips at 1.53 Mbps and above down to 360×640. Chat is more forgiving (about 2.1 Mbps). That is why a video can look sharp in a chat and blurry as a Status.

## How StatusClear fixes it

- Encodes with x264 at full HD 1080×1920 portrait and keeps every clip's average bitrate at or under 1.3 Mbps, checked after encoding and re-encoded lower automatically if needed.
- Wide videos and photos: "Whole picture" (black bars) or "Fill screen" (crop).
- Long videos are split into 30-second Status clips, in order. 60 fps becomes 30 fps; HDR is converted to normal colours.
- Photos and screenshots become a sharp 5-second Status clip, with optional "Zoom into text".

## How to post an HD WhatsApp Status (3 taps, v1.4+)

1. Install StatusClear from https://statusclear.hub2.workers.dev
2. In your Gallery, tap Share on a video or photo and choose "HD Status". StatusClear prepares it in a small sheet (the app doesn't even open) and then opens WhatsApp by itself.
3. Choose "My status" and send.
4. Don't trim, crop or add text inside WhatsApp afterwards: any edit makes WhatsApp re-encode it.

Alternatively, open the StatusClear app for more options (fit or fill wide pictures, zoom into text), then tap "Make HD Status" and "Share to WhatsApp".

Demo video (real phone recording): https://statusclear.hub2.workers.dev/img/quick-share.mp4
